messages:
Alex R: Heads up: third-party pentest kickoff set for 2026-05-10 14:00 UTC. We need to finalize RBAC window, KMS scoping, and audit export plan. Who owns approvals?
Priya S: I can approve the ephemeral role. Proposal: 3-hour window (14:00-17:00 UTC), assessor role limited to read/list on audit buckets and CloudTrail, plus a scoped KMS envelope key for evidence unwrapping only. No long-term credentials.
Devon L: Confirm least-privilege. Assessor role should not have kms:GenerateDataKey or access to customer keys. KMS policy must be explicit: Allow Encrypt/Decrypt for arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/evidence-proxy only.
AuditBot: Command: /prep-evidence-bundle --include cloudtrail,app-audit,iam-snapshot,kms-policy-diff --retention 30d --lock true
Alex R: Good. Also need IAM binding snapshots (terraform + live) and a manifest with object-lock. Devon, can we generate an immutable bundle and presigned URL?
Devon L: Yes. Will stage into s3://redwood-pt-evidence/2026-05-10/ and enable object-lock retention mode for 30 days. Will produce sha256 digest and manifest.json listing files.
Priya S: For the assessor role policy, example allowed actions only: s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket, cloudtrail:LookupEvents, kms:Decrypt (on evidence key). Deny: iam:PassRole, kms:CreateGrant.
Maya D: I'll be oncall that day. Ops note: please route any urgent alerts to #incidents and page me. Also DM me presigned URL when bundle is ready.
Devon L: Question for Security: do we want a separate ephemeral role per assessor or one role with unique session tags for each assessor identity?
Alex R: Prefer separate per-assessor roles to simplify evidence mapping, but if the assessor org insists on single role with distinct session tags that's acceptable if we enforce MFA and tag-based logging.
Priya S: Log requirements for retest: include CloudWatch KMS usage metrics (24h before to 24h after test), CloudTrail entries with requestParameters, and app-audit traces. Also include an IAM role trust diff showing the temporary trust addition.
Devon L: We'll export KMS usage from CloudWatch and include metrics CSV. Also add a small script used to generate presigned URL and the terraform state snapshot.
AuditBot: Checklist: presigned_url, sha256, iam_snapshot.json, cloudtrail_bundle.tar.gz, kms_policy_diff.txt, cw_kms_metrics.csv, runbook.md
Alex R: Retest availability request: two slots — 2026-05-17 morning UTC and 2026-05-24 morning UTC. Add these to the GH remediation tracker so we can reserve.
Priya S: I'll open the remediation tracker (GH project) and create issues for any findings with labels severity/owner/due-date. We'll require remediation PRs to include audit assertions and tests.
Devon L: Dry-run plan: generate ephemeral creds and perform list/get 30 minutes before the window. I'll run the dry-run at 13:30 UTC on 2026-05-10. Please confirm.
Maya D: Confirmed, I'll monitor. If anything fires, page me immediately.
Alex R: Also note: no production customer keys will be referenced. We'll attach a signed attestation describing key isolation for the assessor.
Priya S: After engagement, we'll lock evidence for 30 days then archive to Glacier. Security team to review logs for any unusual access patterns within 48h post-test.
Devon L: I'll post the presigned URL and manifest here when uploaded, plus the ephemeral role ARNs.
AuditBot: Reminder: tag messages with the thread id PT-2026-05-10 for traceability.
Alex R: Thanks everyone — action items: Devon upload bundle, Priya create GH tracker, Maya stand by oncall. We'll run dry-run 13:30 and start at 14:00 UTC.
